text.p: Danish investment company C.W. Obel on Thursday said it had sold its total holding in roadbuilder Phoenix Contractors to Norwegian suitor Rieber and Son.
The C.W. Obel statement did not disclose the size of the stake.
An analysis compiled on February 28 showed Obel with 1.6 percent of Phoenix equity and 5.9 percent of votes.
Shortly after the Obel statement Rieber announced that it now held 35.9 percent of Phoenix equity and 33.7 percent of votes.
It earlier said that it would go ahead with plans to buy Phoenix Contractors if it could build a stake in the company of over 50 percent.

Rieber and rival suitor Icopal have each offered 876 million Danish crowns for Phoenix, comprising 790 crowns per A-share and 710 crowns for the most-traded C-share, its market price at 1345 GMT on Thursday.
Icopal said last week that it held 11.23 percent of Phoenix equity.
